type.markdownDescription:
### ⚠️ Requires [Provi's Origins](https://github.com/Provismet/Provi-Origins/wiki) to be installed! ⚠️

## Swap Positions

---

[Bientity Action Type](https://github.com/Provismet/Provi-Origins/wiki/Bientity-Action-Types)

Swaps the positions of two entities, optionally negative their velocities and fall damage.

Type ID: `proviorigins:swap_positions`

## Fields

---

reset_fall_height.description: Whether or not the fall height/damage of both entities should be reset when swapping their positions.
reset_fall_height.markdownDescription: Whether or not the fall height/damage of both entities should be reset when swapping their positions.

reset_velocity.description: Whether or not the velocities of both entities should be set to zero.
reset_velocity.markdownDescription: Whether or not the velocities of both entities should be set to zero.
